schema6.sqlite.gz is a synthetic database built from the tree at public commit
fcef3fca505af8a58b466652332b787c73864ac0. It contains the accepted
schema-six-run, two imported issues (50 and 90), and their audit history.
It has neither issue_totals nor issue_ci. It contains no deployment data.

Reproduction: archive that revision into a scratch directory, copy
schema6_fixture_test.go.txt to internal/store/perf_fixture_build_test.go
there, and run only TestBuildSchema6Fixture in internal/store. Set
OBERTH_SCHEMA_FIXTURE to a fresh absolute output path. Use the shared gate,
a capped memory scope, Go 1.26.10, and a physical GOTMPDIR/TMPDIR. Close
the store before gzip compression with mtime=0.

Uncompressed SHA256: beaa6530061ad4e710fef05778e286e8eeaaefb9b8c23b17ba22a9df978f5abb

Rollback probe: create a detached scratch worktree at public 909a3db5, copy
schema6_rollback_test.go.txt to internal/store/rollback_probe_test.go there,
and build its store tests with go test -c. Run the current branch's
TestSchema6OpenPreservesBaselineLayout with OBERTH_SCHEMA6_PROBE pointing
at that binary. It opens the database using main's unmodified store code
after the current binary opens it, and reads the accepted run and issues.
Without the variable, the test still checks baseline layout and records.
